explication: Browserslist is a shared target-version query engine for front-end tools. Users or tools provide queries directly or through project configuration; the library parses and resolves them against browser, Node.js, and usage data, returning selected targets. The CLI exposes selection and coverage reporting. The README also documents custom usage statistics, environment-specific configs, and defaults. Core query resolution is concentrated in index.js, while parse.js handles query syntax and node.js supplies filesystem-backed configuration and statistics. Some data-source relationships are documented by imports; unsampled internals are not expanded.
